title: The agent writes the user's notes but can never read them: no user-editable memory document reaches the agent, and its only 'memory' is an unseen auto-summary
subsystem: agent context / memory (context-provider + terminal preamble + notes)
repro: design, verified in code: (1) catalog capability ids include write_note (catalog.py:1373-1395) and no note-read id; (2) captureTerminalState carries charts/watchlist/portfolio/researchSpace but no note text (context-provider.ts:220-320); (3) _render_terminal_preamble renders no notes (agent_runtime.py:376-441); the only notes signal anywhere is a char count for layout ranking (host-actions.ts:999). So: write a thesis for a stock in the Notes panel ('exit if promoter pledge > 20%'), ask the agent 'does the latest shareholding break my thesis?' -> the agent cannot see the thesis. Ask it to 'save this to my BDL note' with mode replace -> it overwrites text it has never read (host-actions.ts:1176-1192).
evidence: sidecar/services/agent_tools/catalog.py:1373-1395, src/modules/chat/context-provider.ts:220-320, sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:376-441, src/lib/host-actions.ts:999, src/lib/host-actions.ts:1176-1192, src/store/research-spaces.ts:33-45 (memory = last 3 user questions, 120 chars each), no .tsx consumer of getMemory (grep), src/modules/agent-builder/AgentBuilderPanel.tsx:304-305 (only per-agent system prompts are editable); world: census/world/agent-native-ux.md W-10 (Notion instructions page; Claude Code CLAUDE.md, 'a document the user can open and edit, not a learned embedding')
notes: World practice W-10 (table stakes): memory is a plain document the user edits and the agent reads every turn. Vysted already has that document (Notes: global plus per-symbol buckets, persisted in the workspace blob) but wired it one-way: agent to note only. Consequence: the product's central 'Jarvis remembers my thesis' moment is impossible (the floor idea 'tie the user's written thesis to new filings' has no input path), research-space memory is invisible and uneditable, and write_note replace is a blind overwrite of user data (the trigger side is filed as COD-host-actions-proposed-changes-2/-3; this finding is the missing read side). Smallest fix: (a) thread the global note plus the focused/research symbol's note (capped, e.g. 1.5k chars each, labelled 'User-written notes — authoritative') through captureTerminalState into the preamble; (b) add a read_note read_handler capability via catalog.py (auto-projects to TOOL_SCHEMAS/allow-list/MCP) for other scopes; (c) show the research-space memory line in the space header with an edit affordance, or drop it in favour of the symbol note. Lives at src/modules/chat/context-provider.ts captureTerminalState + sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py _render_terminal_preamble.

title: No undo for an applied agent change: an accepted or AUTO-applied holding delete, position update or note replace is unrecoverable, and applied changes vanish from the review surface
repro: design, verified in code: agent proposes portfolio_delete_position for a hand-entered holding (or write_note mode=replace on a symbol note) -> user clicks Accept (or AUTO applies it with no click, proposed-changes.ts:118-120) -> apply removes the holding / overwrites the note (host-actions.ts:1376-1389, 1176-1192) -> the change leaves ProposedChangesReview, which renders only status==='pending' (ProposedChangesReview.tsx:27) -> no Undo, no restorable pre-image (the stored 'before' is a prose string, host-actions.ts:790-815), no note/portfolio version history (src/store/notes.ts, src/store/portfolios.ts). The only record is a transcript line 'Applied: Remove X'.
evidence: src/store/proposed-changes.ts:118-120, src/store/proposed-changes.ts:129-170, src/modules/chat/ProposedChangesReview.tsx:27, src/lib/host-actions.ts:790-815, src/lib/host-actions.ts:1176-1192, src/lib/host-actions.ts:1376-1389; world: census/world/agent-native-ux.md W-3 (Claude Code automatic checkpoints before each turn; Cursor snapshots 'restorable from the chat timeline'; Zed 'Restore Checkpoint' after every edit), W-2 (Warp: diff review is the default, auto-accept the opt-out), src/lib/host-actions.ts:545-560
notes: World practice W-3 (table stakes): every agent mutation gets an automatic checkpoint, and the tool states what undo does NOT cover. Vysted has the review half (W-2 present) but no recovery half, so one mis-resolved holding (resolveHolding falls back to the FIRST holding whose base symbol matches, host-actions.ts:555-559, so with two lots of one symbol the wrong lot can be deleted) or a mode-less write_note (COD-host-actions-proposed-changes-2) destroys hand-entered cost bases or a written thesis permanently. COD-host-actions-proposed-changes-3 narrows AUTO's scope but does not help an ASK-mode mistake or a wrong accept. Smallest fix: at accept time, for kind 'data-write' / 'watchlist' / 'settings', capture a restorable pre-image (the holding row, the note text, the watchlist entry) on the ProposedChange; keep the last N applied changes visible under the pending list with an Undo that re-applies the pre-image through the same store seams (and the sidecar position sync); state the boundary in the strip ('Undo restores this app's copy; it cannot un-send anything that left the machine'). Lives in src/store/proposed-changes.ts + src/modules/chat/ProposedChangesReview.tsx.

title: The context window is invisible: token usage is captured and never shown, and after five exchanges older turns silently fall out of the agent's history with no meter, notice or summary
repro: In one chat space: turn 1 'I only care about FY26 guidance vs delivery for BDL, ignore the chart', then five more exchanges -> turn 7 asks 'so does that hold up?' -> the client sends only the last 10 display messages (ChatSidebar.tsx:749-753) and the runtime caps again at 10 (agent_runtime.py:482), so turn 1's constraint is gone; the UI shows nothing to say so. Per-message usage is stored (chat-history.ts:46-47, 213-216) but no component reads message.usage (grep: only the SSE parser at ChatSidebar.tsx:2027-2028). Tool results from earlier turns (fetched figures) never re-enter history at all.
evidence: src/modules/chat/ChatSidebar.tsx:749-753, sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:469-482, src/store/chat-history.ts:46-47, src/store/chat-history.ts:213-216, src/modules/chat/ChatSidebar.tsx:2027-2028; world: census/world/agent-native-ux.md W-5 (Zed shows tokens for the active thread continuously and auto-compacts 'when approaching threshold limits'; 'the user must be able to see the window filling before it fills')
notes: World practice W-5 (table stakes): the window is visible before it fills. Here the window is a fixed 5-exchange sliding cut enforced twice, invisible, with no compaction. For research threads that build a case over many turns this reads as the agent being wrong, not the agent forgetting, which erodes the trust the product is sold on. This raw owns the VISIBILITY half; the compaction/summary mechanism belongs to the harness-context compare (census/world/harness-context.md section 2), so the merge should pair them. Smallest fix: render a quiet context line in the composer meta row (last turn's input tokens vs the resolved model's window, from the model catalog) and a one-time 'earlier turns are no longer in context' marker in the transcript at the cut point; replace the double slice with one budget-based cut owned by the runtime.

title: Delegate launches an unattended, budget-spending run with no plan and runs it with no activity stream: the planner is gated off for delegate mode and the rail shows only tokens and dollars
repro: Switch the composer to Delegate (Option+2), ask a compound task ('screen PSU defence names, compare the top 3, save a note') -> the run starts immediately: _planner_enabled returns False for mode 'delegate' (agent_runtime.py:110-112), so no plan is shown or approved; while it runs, the rail row shows agent name, mode, tokens and $ only (AgentsRail.tsx:94-108; cost.steps is carried but never rendered); research steps and tool actions are reduced to '[tool_use <name>]' strings inside the driver (run_manager.py:164-173) and never reach the client.
evidence: sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:110-112, sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:1387-1413, sidecar/services/run_manager.py:164-181, src/modules/chat/AgentsRail.tsx:94-108, src/lib/delegate-runs.ts:30-38 (RunWire has no activity field), src/modules/chat/ChatSidebar.tsx:838-866; world: census/world/agent-native-ux.md W-1 (Cursor/Claude Code/Warp plan-before-execute; Linear plan as a checklist protocol object), W-7/W-8 (Linear AgentSession states incl. awaitingInput/stale; five typed activities thought/action/elicitation/response/error; 'frozen-in-time snapshots')
notes: World practice: the plan gate sits exactly where an agent spends unattended, and a background run reports through a typed activity stream, not a cost counter. Vysted has it backwards: the foreground turn (cheap, per-change gated) gets an advisory plan, while the one mode that spends BYOK money unwatched gets none. The rest of the Delegate contract is already filed and is NOT re-filed here: result never delivered (COD-runs-durable-delegate-1), no state machine (-5), no boot reconcile (-6), client decides which runs exist (-7), pause unreachable (-10), resume without key/provider (-2). This finding adds the missing plan and in-flight activity halves so the fix is built as one contract. Smallest fix: run the planner for delegate and show the plan in the launch note with Start / Edit before POST /agents/{id}/runs; persist a capped, typed activity list on the run row (plan / action{tool, one-line result} / publish / error) in run_manager._drive_run and render the latest activity plus step count in the AgentsRail row. Lives in sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:_planner_enabled, sidecar/services/run_manager.py:_drive_run, src/modules/chat/AgentsRail.tsx.
